title: Agnes's Notebook
_how: Same format as case-01.json. Every item gets the same pop-in and highlight; nothing is marked differently before 'The Solution.'

items.text: Both doors locked; the only keys in Agnes's apron
Back window open a hand's width at the top: too small for anyone
Mon, Tue, Wed: one silver teaspoon each; Wed also silver foil
Never touched: coin jar, wooden spoons, pewter spoon, sugar, shortbread

items.name: Pip
items.text: can't stand teaspoons; only uses a big spoon

items.name: Mr Fenwick
items.text: at the grocer's from 5 a.m.; driver confirms

items.name: Loveday
items.text: home in bed, with Pickle; neither had keys
On the sill under the gap: long glossy black feather, white patch

solution.text: Locked doors, a bird-sized gap, only shiny things taken, a black-and-white feather: a magpie.
